ROMGAZ Press Release - February 27, 2026 13 Jan 2026 Statement regarding the Azomures press release in relation to ROMGAZ In the press release published on January 12, 2026 Azomures mentioned that ROMGAZ acquisition process of Azomures assets did not progress and that ROMGAZ did not submit a binding offer, considering that from its perspective the due diligence process was completed. At the same time, Azomures presented the operational context referring to uncertainties relating to gas supply and potential social and economic implications of the delays in making decisions. Regarding the aspects mentioned in the aforementioned press release, ROMGAZ provides clarifications in the press release below. Press Release: Statement regarding the Azomures press release in relation to ROMGAZ 22 Dec 2025 ROMGAZ is listing on the Bucharest Stock Exchange the second issue of bonds amounting to EUR 500 million Societatea Națională de Gaze Naturale ROMGAZ S.A, the largest producer and main supplier of natural gas in Romania, company listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) for 12 years (ticker symbol SNG), is listing their second bond issue, worth EUR 500 million, on the Regulated Market of the Stock Exchange.
